title: Email Intent Decoder
description: Surfaces the question behind the question in incoming customer emails and pre-drafts context-aware replies that pre-empt the most likely follow-up contact.

title: Knowledge Base Curator
description: Monitors which KB articles agents skip, flags stale content, and rewrites unclear entries using real call transcripts as training material.

title: Email Quality Scorer
description: Scores outgoing emails on clarity, tone, and first-time-right potential. Flags messages likely to generate follow-up contacts before they leave the queue.

title: Agent Real-Time Coach
description: Listens to live call summaries and whispers coaching cues to agents: escalation signals, upsell moments, empathy prompts, and regulatory compliance flags.

title: Contract Clause Extractor
description: Parses supplier and customer contracts and extracts key obligations, pricing formulas, renewal dates, and penalty clauses into structured JSON for downstream use.

title: Churn Signal Detector
description: Scores customer accounts on churn risk using behavioral signals: contact frequency, complaint history, competitive mentions, and payment patterns.

title: Regulatory Change Scanner
description: Monitors Dutch energy regulation feeds daily, flags changes relevant to Budget Thuis products, and drafts structured compliance memos for legal review.

title: Personalized Energy Report
description: Generates individualized monthly energy reports per customer comparing usage to similar households and recommending specific savings actions.

title: Invoice Anomaly Detector
description: Cross-references supplier invoices against contract rates and market indices, flags discrepancies for human review, and estimates overbilling exposure.

title: Meeting Intelligence Summarizer
description: Turns raw meeting transcripts into structured action items, decisions, open questions, and owners formatted for Notion or email with a single prompt.

title: Process Gap Finder
description: Analyzes CRM event logs and operational data to surface hidden inefficiencies in customer journeys, quantifies the time and cost impact, and drafts a priority fix list.

title: Smart Meter Anomaly Hunter
description: Interprets patterns in smart meter reading streams to flag ghost consumption, meter drift, and potential energy fraud before they surface as billing disputes.
